# Issa Hareb, Full-Stack & AI Engineer, Essen (Germany)

Issa Hareb builds intelligent systems end to end: websites and customer
journeys, custom web applications, AI agents and automations, and the
backend, database and deployment underneath them. Based in Essen,
North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany; works with clients in the German-speaking
market and remotely.
